summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) filed a Form 6-K reporting routine monthly disclosures for July 2026. Items include minor shareholding changes for two vice presidents (5,000 shares each), a small equity disposition of NT$0.7 billion, and issuance of unsecured bonds totaling NT$18.5 billion across two tranches (NT$14.0 billion at 2.03% due 2031; NT$4.5 billion at 2.10% due 2036). No capital appropriations, pledges, or share cancellations were reported. This is a standard periodic filing with no special-situation event, no M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic action. What to watch: routine bond issuance and insider share changes only, no risk-arb implications.
